tdp_basis: Intel Processor Base Power (45 W), used as the documented TDP estimate for the CPU-utilization energy proxy.
host_details_source: Team's Windows PowerShell Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor output: i5-13420H, 8 cores, 12 logical processors.
energy_scope: Estimated CPU-energy proxy; not measured electrical power or total laptop energy.
assumptions: Equal-capacity logical-CPU normalization is an approximation on this 4P+4E hybrid processor.
Idle power, SMT, turbo/DVFS, OEM power limits and virtualization are not explicitly modeled.
